development: Existing GmSSL-only 108 reference combinations and 24 environment portability regressions; no new held-out source used for development this round.
split: Freeze before fetching held-out sources. New implementation families; no former Guomi samples or old validation libraries reused. Shared upstream ancestry disclosed separately.
target: At least 5 new upstream projects, at least 30 operation/helper modules, at least 500 distinct source/stripped ELF objects; report actual counts and correlated build variants.
selection: SM2 signature/encryption where offered, SM3 hashing, SM4 key schedule/block cipher; predeclared generic arithmetic, AES, SHA, GOST, encoding/control negatives when available. No prediction-based inclusion/exclusion.
build: Six ELF architectures x O0/O2/Os, Zig/Clang 18.1.6; source bytes unchanged, config headers separate; hidden/localized/stripped definitions; retained expected operation bodies; unresolved auxiliaries allowed; no execution.
ground_truth: Human review of operation bodies before scanning; API-only references and generic elliptic curve arithmetic are not implementations. Source labels per file, binary labels per linked module. API references not scored.
failures: All attempts and compile failures retained, report build coverage separately; every locked object scanned; partial/failed scans remain in denominator.
metrics: TP FP FN TN, precision recall F1, exact label-set match; by algorithm/project/architecture/optimization and source/binary. Do not headline true-negative-dominated accuracy.
no_tuning: No detector code/rules/reference/threshold updates from freeze through results. Only benchmark download/build/label preparation before first scan. No corpus relabel/rebuild/reselection after lock.
immutability: Preserve old validation and other_ref; hash scanner/deps/corpus before and after; audit exact byte overlap with prior sources/references/old validation. Exact nonidentity does not prove genealogical independence.
